external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Bekkjarvik Gjestgiveri Hotel & Suites Google profile: rating 4.6/5, 1043 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Great Restaurant with a nice traditional norwegian menu.. we had REKESMØRBRØD og LAKSESMØRBRØD which were extremely delicious!!! Also to recommend the non alcoholic beer from ELØ, very tasty , very friendly staff!!

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Words can’t describe the ever lasting memories that I’ll have from this stay and experience. Everyone from breakfast to lunch to dinner to bedtime was perfection. I dined in both restaurants and will never forget those moments — best food of my life. I’ll forever hold these memories near and dear to my heart. Thank you to everyone at Beckerwyk House for making my stay the most unforgettable!

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Came for the famous fish soup today after previously having it in 2015. It was not the same soup!!! It tasted like they had forgotten to add cream. There were no prawns or mussels in there, just 3 small pieces of under cooked white fish. To top it all off it was cold. Such a shame.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: The 5 course fixed menu was phenomenal. The food and wine was outstanding and Marcin, our server for the evening, made it so enjoyable and memorable. Thanks so much !

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: I was just visiting the area, I cannot review the rooms, but the food there is excellent! 6 ⭐ or more! 😊 I really recommend the fish soup, it was excellent, together with the bread and the foamy butter. My kid was thrilled to have the kid's burger. The dessert, cheesecake with passion fruit and strawberry sorbet... 🤤 again 6 ⭐ ... Excellent experience, nice restaurant, for sure I will be back there.
